      "evidence": "Adds `getMemoryLoad()` to `src/interfaces/mining.h` and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`, and updates node context lifetime to ensure safe asynchronous IPC template cleanup on shutdown.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "It completes the IPC mining interface by allowing external mining processes like Stratum v2 template providers to track and manage template memory load across the IPC boundary. The description notes this enables external clients to prune stale templates (stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63) and hardens node shutdown lifetime against IPC cleanup races."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Mining' and modifies `BlockTemplateManager` (`src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`) along with the mining interface to track block template memory usage.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides visibility and control over memory pinned by external mining clients holding stale block templates with evicted mempool transactions. Reviewers note this is strategically valuable for hardening the mining interface and tracking resource usage for downstream consumers such as Stratum v2."
